secondary_findings: First check precedes result_path assignment; entry failure cannot create the local result file.
Old CRC counter is set before bad-member test; fix its semantics in the additive replacement.

cost_separation.outer_internal_discrepancy: Retained without silently replacing either observation; timing scope/formatting not resolved from preserved records.

cache_observation.scope: Metadata only. No current-turn claim that all 116 payload bytes were revalidated.
cache_observation.proposed_input_selection: Exactly the pinned manifest list; never recursively package the 147-file directory.

backup_reuse.verification_tier: Reuse historical completed upload ACKs plus current ID/size metadata. No new download or full-byte hash equality assertion for either remote object.

proposal.interpretation: A requested consumption ceiling with contingency, not a benchmark or guaranteed completion-time estimate. Unmeasured historical and diagnostic costs remain unknown.
proposal.restoration_scope: No restore; existing cache reuse only. Cache failure terminates the attempt.
proposal.output: One create-only whole-unit ZIP containing exactly 116 original payloads plus SOURCE_MANIFEST.json.
proposal.verification: One full ZIP CRC pass and one full ZIP SHA-256 pass, plus exact pinned input checks.
proposal.metering: Worker final user+system from wait4 after exit; per-phase deltas retained. Supervisor SELF prefix and remaining reporting reserve stay separate. External whole-supervisor meter required; pre-serialization snapshots never labeled full final CPU.
proposal.post_success: Upload the completed ZIP to both existing backup providers and require completed ACKs and matching metadata; retain source pin, payload count, actual CPU, CRC and SHA-256. No scientific/DAG promotion.
proposal.hard_limit_claim: No claim that cooperative signal/check guards can never overshoot at clock-tick or signal-delivery precision.

execution_this_continuation.python_capability: Not probed for this diagnostic; prior PYTHON_PASS is historical only. No runtime unavailable assertion.
execution_this_continuation.local_operations: Read-only directory/path metadata and source-code reads; additive text/code preparation. Those operations are not charged as zero.

review.diagnosis_method: Independent static reading of frozen helper and preserved records; no runtime.
review.repair_review: Two actual findings closed by targeted independent static readback; no further audit loop.

repair.review_method: Independent source reading, one targeted repair, source-read closure only.

review_findings.resolution: Handle SIGPROF/SIGXCPU once; repeated CPU signals do not interrupt cleanup; nonrenewed one-second wall cleanup bound. CPU overrun is reported, not erased.
Preserve raw internal CPU before conversion; for finite nonnegative values preserve max(wait4, internal) before consistency failure.

repair.claim_scope: Prepared delivery implementation only; no runtime PASS, elapsed-cost prediction, source-byte revalidation, or ZIP completion claim.
